notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34648176/e25e10d94c0d8373a381e1413cc61866cc30ac62.png[/img]

[b]We are glad to announce the release of a small update for Desktop Girls. After the launch of the software we gathered all the suggestions and bugs reported from the Community, and we tried to implement as many as we could. We couldn't manage to develop everything in one go but fear not, as many of the things suggested will be release in the coming updates. 

And here comes the best news: the first DLC for Desktop Girls is planned to be released sometime in the near future![/b]


[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[list]
[*] 	[b]Girl Moving Outside the screen, fixed:[/b] we received many complaints about this issue, so now the girl will not go outside the screen anymore.

[*] 	[b]Full Nudity Option added:[/b] on the start screen, check this option to allow girls to have one more outfit... or rather not to have one!

[*] 	[b]High Quality Option added:[/b]on the start screen, check this option to change the quality settings (texture resolution, shadow, camera effects, and so on).

[*] 	[b]Mute feature[/b] in beginning screen

[*] 	[b]Resize girl feature:[/b] we added a slider just under the “Rotation” one to adjust a girl’s size.

[*] 	[b]Play Music:[/b] once the transparent scene is launched, check this option in the in-game menu to play a song.
[/list]

notes.title: Community Pool
notes.content:
Hello Folks, we have good news! An update is arriving shortly (few days) with some bug fixes and some new implemented features. At the same time we are working on the first DLC package. Because of this we would like to ask the opinion of the people who tried the software so far. If you are among those people, what additional content would you like to see? These are the three options:

[list]
[*] [b]More Girls[/b] (we can arrange a pack of 4 new girls with the same clothes of the existing ones)
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34648176/6aa1b287a46459f66e84e078564db09c541814cd.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b] More Cloths[/b] (meaning the chance to choose from 20 outfits per girl instead of the actual 6)
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34648176/2be8b1a90183365e84c95061f31620a72243bbb2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]More Dance Animations[/b] (we will add a wider range of different animations)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34648176/509f6861a73f4e3a14aae0d3f1952a9a1349d704.png[/img]

So please cast your vote (by writing a comment to this post), [b]ONLY ONE[/b] preference each. We will develop the option that will receive more votes.
